run_acp_agent_prompt: run the Hermes ACP agent on a session with a text prompt and return the agent response
create_acp_session: create a new ACP session with a working directory and optional MCP servers
build_acp_agent: build a HermesACPAgent instance that exposes Hermes via the Agent Client Protocol
switch_acp_session_model: switch the LLM model for an existing ACP session by provider and model name
list_acp_sessions: list all active ACP sessions with their session IDs, working directories, and titles
